content.short: Gamma.io is a Bitcoin NFT marketplace powered by Stacks, with a creator launchpad and a social platform for creators and collectors.
content.description: Gamma.io is a Bitcoin NFT marketplace that enables smart contracts to settle on Bitcoin, creating a native venue for Bitcoin-based NFTs. It provides an open marketplace for Bitcoin NFTs, a creator launchpad for 100% creator-owned Ethereum projects, and a social space that connects creators and collectors in a Web3-native way. Gamma's user profiles let collectors consolidate multiple Stacks and Ethereum wallets on one page to display all their NFTs and share profiles rooted in decentralized identity.
content.meta: Gamma.io is a Bitcoin NFT marketplace powered by Stacks enabling Bitcoin-settled smart contracts. Discover Gamma.io and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
